text:
The mouse eradication operation on Gough Island began in **2021**, not 2011, though the programme was set up around 2020. My earlier description was wrong: the 2021 field team reached the island on 3 June 2021, and the first island-wide bait distribution was announced on 24 June, not in late 2021. Sources: [Daily Maverick](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2021-07-12-gough-island-mission-to-stop-mighty-mice-from-literally-eating-threatened-seabirds-alive-in-south-atlantic/), [UKOTA archive, March 2020](https://ukota.org/2020/03/), [SAnAP](https://www.sanap.ac.za/?p=32982).
